fact: Congo's government said on 22 September 2026 that works on the national data centre stood at 82% and that the Kintelé solar farm, 19,354 panels of 12 MW, is being built to keep its power supply stable; neither is yet in service.
ARPCE's 27 October 2026 communiqué says nationwide power cuts and scarce diesel strongly disrupt technical sites, core networks and data centres in Congo.
